thread:
noah: quick follow-up from AH about runway and the new funding controls. couple quick asks for my team: 1) who approves small infra buys now, 2) p-card caps, 3) how do we get an urgent demo unblocked? cc @camille @rahul

camille (CFO): short answers: runway is ~15 months at plan; approval bands tightened; p-card caps reduced for new hires. details below.

noah: can you spell out the bands so I can update team doc?

camille (CFO): effective now: <$3k = manager approval; $3k$30k = procurement + finance; $30k$300k = senior finance sign-off + procurement; >$300k = CFO + legal + procurement + enterprise onboarding.

leah (product): p-card numbers? any changes for project leads?

camille (CFO): default p-card single txn cap = $3k; monthly rolling cap = $12k. project leads can request an exception via the Spend Request form which needs two approvers and justification. cards cannot be used for new-vendor setup fees > $3k.

rahul (procurement): vendor onboarding SLA = 7 business days for standard vendors; 14 for elevated risk. please attach the complete onboarding packet or it will pause. we keep a pre-vetted infra vendor list to speed buys.

kai (ops): for urgent demo failures: submit Spend Request tagged "demo-unblock" + ping @rahul + @kai. procurement can provision a temporary PO or approve a p-card exception up to $10k while onboarding completes. ops has a small contingency fund for sub-$8k unblocks.

noah: who signs off on an $18k urgent GPU burst?

camille (CFO): $18k = procurement + finance. mark as "demo-unblock" and we'll prioritize; CFO only if > $30k. aim for 48-hr turnaround for verified customer-impact requests.

legal-bot: reminder: any contract with data residency, indemnity, or SLA implications must route to legal regardless of amount. use the contract intake template.

noah: can you drop the Spend Request link and a subject line to use when emailing procurement?

camille (CFO): link: https://internal.redwood.com/spend-request (internal only). Email subject template: "Spend Request - [Project] - [Vendor] - Est $XXXX - Expedite: yes/no". Body: 1-2 sentence justification, cost center, approvers, attach onboarding docs.

rahul (procurement): i'll hold a 15-min office hour tomorrow 10:00-10:15 for real cases. drop your request in the calendar.

noah: awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
